For each equipment reference with nonmissing humidity readings, return up to 10 whose average exceeds the mean of equipment averages; report its average, its excess over that mean, and its signed difference from the kept-equipment mean (kept mean minus equipment average), sorted by that difference descending

For equipment above the mean of equipment averages, calculate the final value as the absolute distance from the average of all nonmissing humidity readings for the kept equipment; return the 10 highest values

For equipment above the mean of equipment averages, calculate the final value as its average humidity minus the average of all nonmissing humidity readings for the kept equipment; return the 10 highest values

queries:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    equipref,
    avg_humidity,
    avg_humidity - (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages) AS excess
  FROM equipment_averages
  WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)
),
kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT
    equipref,
    avg_humidity,
    excess,
    ABS(avg_humidity - AVG(avg_humidity) OVER ()) AS distance_from_kept_mean
  FROM above_mean
)
SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess, distance_from_kept_mean
FROM kept_equipment
ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
),
kept AS (
    SELECT equipref, avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
    WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT mean_humidity FROM overall_mean)
),
kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM kept
)
SELECT
    k.equipref,
    k.avg_humidity,
    k.avg_humidity - o.mean_humidity AS excess_over_mean,
    k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
),
kept AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.mean_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.mean_humidity
    ORDER BY e.avg_humidity ASC, e.equipref
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
    equipref,
    avg_humidity,
    avg_humidity - mean_humidity AS excess_over_mean,
    AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () - avg_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC

WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT equipref
  FROM equipment_averages
  WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)
),
kept_readings AS (
  SELECT humepct
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    AND equipref IN (SELECT equipref FROM kept_equipment)
)
SELECT ABS(humepct - (SELECT AVG(humepct) FROM kept_readings)) AS final_value
FROM kept_readings
ORDER BY final_value DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
),
kept_equipment AS (
    SELECT equipref, avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
    WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment AS se
    JOIN kept_equipment AS ke ON se.equipref = ke.equipref
    WHERE se.humepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ke.equipref,
       ke.avg_humidity - oa.avg_humidity AS final_value
FROM kept_equipment AS ke
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
ORDER BY final_value DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY equipref
),
kept_equipment AS (
    SELECT equipref, avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
    WHERE avg_humidity > (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) FROM equipment_averages)
),
kept_readings_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment AS se
    JOIN kept_equipment AS ke ON ke.equipref = se.equipref
    WHERE se.humepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT kra.avg_humidity - ke.avg_humidity AS final_value
FROM kept_equipment AS ke
CROSS JOIN kept_readings_average AS kra
ORDER BY final_value DESC
LIMIT 10
